title: New Taipei's Christmasland Festival Lights Up Banqiao Until 27 December
summaryZh: 新北耶誕城11/13開幕，點燈至12/27
summaryHi: न्यू ताइपे का क्रिसमसलैंड उत्सव 13 नवंबर से 27 दिसंबर तक रोशनी और बाज़ारों के साथ
summaryEs: El festival Christmasland de Nuevo Taipéi abre el 13 de noviembre y dura hasta el 27 de diciembre
summaryJa: 新北市のクリスマスランドが11月13日開幕、12月27日まで光と市場で彩る
summaryKo: 신베이 크리스마스랜드 11월 13일 개막, 12월 27일까지 빛과 마켓으로 장식
summaryEn: New Taipei's Christmasland festival opens on 13 November with lights, markets and shows until 27 December
paragraphs: New Taipei City's annual Christmasland festival opens on 13 November and runs until 27 December, offering light displays, themed markets and holiday performances, the city government announced.

A trial lighting of the festival's main Christmas tree, on the north side of New Taipei City Hall in Banqiao, took place on 11 November. Inside the City Hall lobby, a giant inflatable featuring a Japanese illustrator's popular cartoon animals greets visitors.

The pedestrian bridge linking City Hall with the Mega City department store has been transformed into a 'floral gallery' tunnel, decorated with lights and artificial roses, while laser shows will illuminate the building's facade.

Christmas markets selling food and souvenirs will open daily at New Taipei City Plaza and Banqiao Station Plaza, and on weekends at Fuzhong Plaza. Highlights include a children's circus carnival on 14 and 15 November, a winter sports day featuring a snowball-fight game on 22 November, a German Christmas market from 4 to 6 December and a choir concert on 20 December.
With large crowds expected over the 45-day event, organisers are urging visitors to travel by public transport.
New Taipei City has a big Christmas festival again this year. It is called Christmasland. It starts on 13 November and ends on 27 December.

The main Christmas tree is next to New Taipei City Hall in Banqiao. The city tested its lights on 11 November. Inside the City Hall, there is a very big balloon of cute cartoon animals from a Japanese artist.
A bridge for walkers goes from City Hall to a big shop. It looks like a tunnel of flowers, with lights and roses that are not real. At night, there are laser light shows on the City Hall building.
There are Christmas markets with food and gifts every day. Children can see a circus on 14 and 15 November. There is a German Christmas market from 4 to 6 December.
Many people will come. The city asks visitors to take the train or bus.

paragraphs: New Taipei City's yearly Christmas festival, Christmasland, opens on 13 November and runs until 27 December. The city government says visitors can enjoy colourful lights, markets and shows.

The festival's main Christmas tree stands on the north side of New Taipei City Hall in Banqiao. Its lights were tested on the evening of 11 November. Inside the building, a huge inflatable of cartoon animals by a Japanese illustrator welcomes visitors.
The walkway between City Hall and the Mega City department store has become a 'flower tunnel', decorated with lights and artificial roses. Laser shows will also light up the front of City Hall.

Christmas markets selling food and souvenirs open every day at New Taipei City Plaza and Banqiao Station Plaza, and at weekends at Fuzhong Plaza. There is a children's circus on 14 and 15 November, a winter sports day with a snowball game on 22 November, and a German Christmas market from 4 to 6 December.
Organisers expect large crowds during the 45-day event, so they advise people to use public transport.

paragraphs: New Taipei City's annual Christmasland festival gets under way on 13 November, transforming the area around City Hall in Banqiao into a seasonal attraction of illuminations, markets and live entertainment until 27 December.

Ahead of the opening, the city's Tourism and Travel Department held a trial lighting of the centrepiece Christmas tree on the north side of City Hall. Indoors, the lobby is dominated by an enormous inflatable of a Japanese illustrator's much-loved cartoon animals.

The footbridge connecting City Hall to the neighbouring Mega City department store has been reimagined as a 'floral gallery', its tunnel adorned with artificial roses and strings of lights, while laser projections will play across the building's facade.

Food and souvenir stalls will trade daily at New Taipei City Plaza and Banqiao Station Plaza, with an additional weekend market at Fuzhong Plaza. The programme also features a children's circus carnival on 14 and 15 November, a winter sports day built around a snowball-fight version of capture the flag on 22 November, a German-style Christmas market from 4 to 6 December, celebrity performances on 12 and 13 December and a choral concert on 20 December.
Anticipating heavy crowds throughout the 45-day run, organisers are encouraging visitors to leave their cars at home and use public transport.
sentZh: 新北市一年一度的耶誕城於11月13日登場，將板橋市政府周邊化身為充滿燈飾、市集和現場表演的季節景點，直到12月27日。
開幕前，市府觀光旅遊局在市政府北側為主角耶誕樹舉行了試燈。
室內大廳最搶眼的是一座日本插畫家深受喜愛的卡通動物巨型充氣裝置。
連接市政府與鄰近大遠百百貨的天橋被重新打造成「花廊」，隧道裝飾著人造玫瑰和串串燈飾，雷射投影也將在大樓外牆上演。
美食和紀念品攤位每天在新北市民廣場和板橋車站廣場營業，週末另有府中廣場的市集。
活動還包括11月14日和15日的兒童馬戲嘉年華、11月22日以打雪仗版奪旗遊戲為主軸的冬季運動日、12月4日至6日的德式耶誕市集、12月12日和13日的明星表演，以及12月20日的合唱音樂會。
預料為期45天的活動期間將人潮洶湧，主辦單位鼓勵遊客把車留在家裡，改搭大眾運輸。

paragraphs: New Taipei City's annual Christmasland festival commences on 13 November, with the municipal government promising more than six weeks of illuminations, themed markets and festive performances centred on City Hall in Banqiao. The event will conclude on 27 December.

In preparation, the city's Tourism and Travel Department conducted a trial illumination of the festival's centrepiece tree on the north side of City Hall. Visitors entering the lobby are greeted by a colossal inflatable depicting a Japanese illustrator's immensely popular cartoon animals, a feature clearly designed to appeal to families and younger tourists.

Meanwhile, the pedestrian bridge between City Hall and the adjacent Mega City department store has been converted into a 'floral gallery' tunnel embellished with artificial roses and lights, and laser displays will be projected onto the building's facade.

Markets offering food and souvenirs will operate daily at two central plazas, supplemented by a weekend market at Fuzhong Plaza. Scheduled highlights encompass a children's circus carnival in mid-November, a winter sports day incorporating a snowball-fight variant of capture the flag, a German Christmas market in early December and a choral concert on 20 December.
Given the substantial crowds anticipated over the 45-day festival, organisers strongly recommend that visitors rely on public transport rather than private vehicles.
sentZh: 新北市一年一度的耶誕城於11月13日開幕，市政府承諾在板橋市政府一帶舉辦超過六週的燈飾、主題市集和節慶表演。
活動將於12月27日結束。
為做準備，市府觀光旅遊局在市政府北側為活動的主角耶誕樹進行了試燈。
走進大廳的遊客會看到一座描繪日本插畫家超人氣卡通動物的巨大充氣裝置，這顯然是為了吸引家庭和年輕遊客而設計的。
同時，市政府與相鄰大遠百百貨之間的人行天橋已改造成以人造玫瑰和燈光點綴的「花廊」隧道，雷射光影也將投射在大樓外牆上。
提供美食與紀念品的市集將每天在兩處中心廣場營業，週末另有府中廣場市集作為補充。
排定的亮點包括11月中旬的兒童馬戲嘉年華、融入打雪仗版奪旗遊戲的冬季運動日、12月初的德國耶誕市集，以及12月20日的合唱音樂會。
由於預計為期45天的活動將湧入大量人潮，主辦單位強烈建議遊客搭乘大眾運輸，而非自行開車。
